elements.requirement: Section 5A of the Value Added Tax Act 1994 applies where a person ("P") makes a taxable supply of goods in the course or furtherance of a business to another person ("R"), that supply is facilitated by an online marketplace, and either the imported consignment condition is met or the supply does not involve importation but P is established outside the United Kingdom.
elements.quote: This section applies where— (a) a person (“P”) makes a taxable supply of goods in the course or furtherance of a business to another person (“R”)

elements.requirement: Section 5A of the Value Added Tax Act 1994 does not apply where a person ("P") is established outside the United Kingdom and the imported consignment condition is not met if the recipient ("R") is registered under the Act, R has provided the operator of the online marketplace with R's VAT registration number, and the operator has provided P with that number and details of the supply before the end of the relevant period.
elements.quote: this section does not apply in a case where P is established outside the United Kingdom and the imported consignment condition is not met

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the Value Added Tax Act 1994, where section 5A applies, the person supplying the goods ("P") is treated as having supplied the goods to the operator of the online marketplace.
elements.quote: P is to be treated as having supplied the goods to the operator of the online marketplace

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the Value Added Tax Act 1994, where section 5A applies, the operator of the online marketplace is treated as having supplied the goods to the recipient ("R") in the course or furtherance of a business carried on by the operator.
elements.quote: the operator is to be treated as having supplied the goods to R in the course or furtherance of a business carried on by the operator

elements.requirement: The imported consignment condition is met where the supply of goods to the recipient ("R") involves the goods being imported, the intrinsic value of the consignment is not more than £135, and the consignment contains no excepted goods and is not subject to an agreement between the Commissioners and an overseas postal operator to pay import VAT chargeable on that importation.
elements.quote: The imported consignment condition is met where— (a) the supply of the goods to R involves those goods being imported

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the imported consignment condition, "excepted goods" are goods of a class or description subject to any excise duty, regardless of whether that duty is chargeable in fact or has been paid.
elements.quote: “excepted goods” means goods of a class or description subject to any duty of excise whether or not those goods are in fact chargeable with that duty

elements.requirement: The Commissioners may by regulations specify the details that must be provided by the operator of the online marketplace to the supplying person ("P") for the purposes of subsection (1A)(c).
elements.quote: The Commissioners may by regulations— (a) specify the details that must be provided for the purposes of subsection (1A)(c)

elements.requirement: The Commissioners may by regulations substitute a different figure for the figure specified at any time in subsection (3)(b).
elements.quote: substitute a different figure for a figure that is at any time specified in subsection (3)(b)

elements.requirement: The "relevant period" is defined as the period of 7 days beginning with the day on which the supply is treated as taking place under section 6, or such longer period as allowed by the Commissioners in general or specific directions.
elements.quote: “relevant period” means the period of 7 days beginning with the day on which the supply is treated as taking place under section 6 or such longer period as the Commissioners may allow

elements.requirement: A "VAT registration number" is defined as the number allocated by the Commissioners to a person registered under the Value Added Tax Act 1994.
elements.quote: “VAT registration number” means the number allocated by the Commissioners to a person registered under this Act

thresholds.what: maximum intrinsic value of the consignment for the imported consignment condition to be met
thresholds.quote: the intrinsic value of the consignment of which the goods are part is not more than £135
